Cameco Corporation (formerly Canadian Mining and Energy Corporation) is the world's largest publicly traded uranium company, based in Saskatoon, Saska
Cameco Corporation is a major supplier of uranium processing services required to produce fuel for the generation of clean electricity.
Cameco operates uranium mines in North America and Kazakhstan, including McArthur River-Key Lake, the world's largest uranium producer, and Cigar Lake
We sell uranium and fuel services directly to nuclear utilities around the world as uranium concentrates, UO 2 and UF 6, conversion services, or fuel
